0022600158.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-2, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, 6th in the West, 1-2 on the road, currently on a two-game losing streak) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-2, 2nd in the Central and 1 game back, 4th in the East, 3-0 at home, on a one-game winning streak) in the Thunder's seventh game of the season. Oklahoma City will be without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and has Peyton Watson listed as day-to-day with hamstring soreness. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 121-113 win in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
